_help: What the MCP server (app-tests/mcp, started with MCP_APP=instagram) needs to know about this app: its name and package, the .env key of the device id, the device suites the assistant may start (npm run test:<suite>) and what a run does to the device. The assistant shows 'effects' to the user before a run starts.
name: Instagram

smoke.what: login with valid and invalid credentials, then log in and out again (3 tests)

home.what: the Home feed after login (3 tests)

profile.what: the profile screen after login (5 tests)

menu.what: the profile menu after login (4 tests)

effects: The tests use the REAL Instagram app and log in to Instagram with the account in .env (a wrong-password attempt is part of the login tests).
Instagram is restarted for the run; its data is not cleared.
